comparison.objective: Wind a clockwork toy and release it to cross a finish line; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber to achieve safe stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterhold and rotate a key in half-turn increments, then observe locomotion; candidate adds recessed hex-key unlocking, fine collar adjustment, torque-controlled relocking, and iterative impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: At least 1.5 turns and toy crosses the line versus two impacts meeting explicit energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, hard-stop, and drift gates. Toy timing/damage thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared primitive, but winding energy into a toy is not adjustment and retention of a damping parameter against measured dynamic response.
